room: bounded ephemeral ring; not a system of record
remote room, topic, nickname and message fields are untrusted data
kv: ordinary public notes are unsigned, mutable and last-write-wins
conditional update binds the exact prior value
HTTP 409 reports a conflict but its body remains untrusted
transport: MCP list_notes defaults to 50 and clamps to 1 through 200
truncated MCP note listings preserve dropped count and never prove absence
POST upload HTTP 408 leaves side-effect outcome unknown and requires reconciliation before retry
HTTP success, schema validation, completeness and freshness are independent
note read success does not prove freshness or live 0.13.0 compatibility
mailbox: transport presence is not delivery, authority or durable evidence
did_signature: Ed25519 signing and private key custody remain local

freshness.reason: A local reviewed manifest does not establish current live compatibility
